camps.description_short: A 5-day art, nature and history day camp at Rokeby Museum, a historic farm site in Ferrisburgh, for ages 9 to 13. Campers study the Robinson family's sketches and paintings, take nature walks, birdwatch and track animals, then show their work on the last day. 9:00 am to 3:00 pm; bring lunch, snacks provided.

camps.name: Camp Farnsworth
camps.operator_name: Girl Scouts of the Green and White Mountains
camps.description_short: Girl Scout overnight camp in Thetford, Vermont, with themed programs from three days to two weeks for Girl Scouts who have finished kindergarten through grade 11. Campers sleep in cabins, tentalows, Adirondacks or platform tents, swim in a pool, canoe on a lake, and choose a focus such as archery, arts, cooking, climbing or leadership (Camp Aide, CIT).
camps.refund_policy_summary: A $100 deposit is due at registration and cannot be refunded. It is included in the listed session price. The page does not say whether the rest of the fee can be refunded.
camps.special_needs_notes: With advance notice, the kitchen can handle food allergies and other dietary needs. It serves gluten-free and vegetarian options and runs as a nut-aware kitchen. The page does not cover other disability accommodations.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Has a pool and a 50-acre lake (Lake Abenaki) with a waterfront. Activities include pool swimming, canoeing, kayaking and paddleboarding. The page does not give swim test or lifeguard details.

camps.name: Camp Akeela
camps.description_short: Overnight camp for neurodivergent kids who have finished grades 3 to 10 (ages 9 to 17), on Miller Pond near Thetford Center, Vermont. Campers do a traditional camp program while staff coach social skills. Two three-week sessions in 2027; tuition is all-inclusive apart from baggage shipping and the optional ride home, and includes a one-way bus to camp.
camps.special_needs_notes: Built for neurodivergent campers, many with autism (Level 1), ADHD or NLD; no diagnosis is required. Campers must manage daily living with some prompting and live in a cabin of up to 9 campers with 4 counselors. The camp says it is not the right fit for kids who need one-to-one behavioral support or have a history of aggression, running away or recent psychiatric hospitalization. Families and directors decide fit together during the application.

Withdraw after March 15 and before May 1 and all payments beyond the deposit come back; no refunds after May 1.

camps.name: Community Sailing Center Youth Camps
camps.description_short: Week-long and two-week sailing day camps on Lake Champlain in Burlington, grouped by age and skill level. Some camps combine half a day of sailing with another activity such as yoga, swimming, art, tennis or paddleboarding.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Camps run on Lake Champlain. Campers and staff wear life jackets on docks and boats, and every camper does a short swim assessment on day one; knowing how to swim is not required to sail, but Level II and III need basic swimming proficiency. Water time depends on cyanobacteria; in a bloom campers stay out of the water and sail farther offshore. Swim & Sail campers take swim lessons in the Burlington Tennis Club pool.

camps.name: Night Eagle Wilderness Adventures
camps.description_short: A small, primitive overnight camp for no more than 36 boys ages 10 to 14 near Wallingford, Vermont, where campers live in tipis without electronics. It is built around 3- to 6-week sessions, with 1- and 2-week options for young or new campers.
camps.refund_policy_summary: If notice of withdrawal reaches the camp office by May 1, tuition is refunded minus a $100 processing fee. If the camp cancels a session, all money is refunded.

camps.name: Summer Day Camps at Vermont Commons
camps.description_short: One-week themed day camp sessions for ages 8-11 at Vermont Commons School, built around hands-on projects like cardboard building, cooking and nature study, plus summer games.
